1.web: Of Moab. Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Woe to Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is disappointed, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.
1.asv: Of Moab. Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe unto Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

2.web: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. You also, Madmen, shall be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue you.
2.asv: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. Thou also, O Madmen, shalt be brought to silence; the sword shall pursue thee.

3.web: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!
3.asv: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

4.web: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
4.asv: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

5.web: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.
5.asv: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

6.web: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
6.asv: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

7.web: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also shall be taken: and Chemosh shall go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.
7.asv: For, because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou also shalt be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

8.web: The destroyer shall come on every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Yahweh has spoken.
8.asv: And the destroyer shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Jehovah hath spoken.

9.web: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.
9.asv: Give wings unto Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.

10.web: Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.
10.asv: Cursed be he that doeth the work of Jehovah negligently; and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.

11.web: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.
11.asv: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remaineth in him, and his scent is not changed.

12.web: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will send to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.
12.asv: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will send unto him them that pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.

13.web: Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
13.asv: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.

14.web: How do you say, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?
14.asv: How say ye, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?

15.web: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.
15.asv: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is Jehovah of hosts.

16.web: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.
16.asv: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

17.web: All you who are around him, bemoan him, and all you who know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!
17.asv: All ye that are round about him, bemoan him, and all ye that know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!

18.web: You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, he has destroyed your strongholds.
18.asv: O thou daughter that dwellest in Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab is come up against thee, he hath destroyed thy strongholds.

19.web: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, What has been done?
19.asv: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth; say, What hath been done?

20.web: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.
20.asv: Moab is put to shame; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell ye it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

21.web: Judgment has come on the plain country, on Holon, and on Jahzah, and on Mephaath,
21.asv: And judgment is come upon the plain country, upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath,

22.web: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth Diblathaim,
22.asv: and upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,

23.web: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth Gamul, and on Beth Meon,
23.asv: and upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,

24.web: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
24.asv: and upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

25.web: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahweh.
25.asv: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith Jehovah.

26.web: Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
26.asv: Make ye him drunken; for he magnified himself against Jehovah: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

27.web: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? was he found among thieves? for as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.
27.asv: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for as often as thou speakest of him, thou waggest the head.

28.web: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.
28.asv: O ye inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that maketh her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

29.web: We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.
29.asv: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogancy, and the haughtiness of his heart.

30.web: I know his wrath, says Yahweh, that it is nothing; his boastings have worked nothing.
30.asv: I know his wrath, saith Jehovah, that it is nought; his boastings have wrought nothing.

31.web: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yes, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir Heres shall they mourn.
31.asv: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yea, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir-heres shall they mourn.

32.web: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for you, vine of Sibmah: your branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: on your summer fruits and on your vintage the destroyer is fallen.
32.asv: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for thee, O vine of Sibmah: thy branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage the destroyer is fallen.

33.web: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses: no one shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.
33.asv: And gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.

34.web: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.
34.asv: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, even unto Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, to Eglath-shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.

35.web: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahweh, him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.
35.asv: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith Jehovah, him that offereth in the high place, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

36.web: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like pipes, and my heart sounds like pipes for the men of Kir Heres: therefore the abundance that he has gotten is perished.
36.asv: Therefore my heart soundeth for Moab like pipes, and my heart soundeth like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: therefore the abundance that he hath gotten is perished.

37.web: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: on all the hands are cuttings, and on the waist sackcloth.
37.asv: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands are cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

38.web: On all the housetops of Moab and in its streets there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights, says Yahweh.
38.asv: On all the housetops of Moab and in the streets thereof there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein none delighteth, saith Jehovah.

39.web: How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.
39.asv: How is it broken down! how do they wail! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all that are round about him.

40.web: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.
40.asv: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.

41.web: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
41.asv: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

42.web: Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.
42.asv: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against Jehovah.

43.web: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are on you, inhabitant of Moab, says Yahweh.
43.asv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith Jehovah.

44.web: He who flees from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahweh.
44.asv: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon him, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith Jehovah.

45.web: Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
45.asv: They that fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and hath devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

46.web: Woe to you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.
46.asv: Woe unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for thy sons are taken away captive, and thy daughters into captivity.

47.web: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
47.asv: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith Jehovah. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
